decisionsForArchitect: Root A3 (dispatch://INFRA-191/spec, approved v18) names legion-envoy's token; the child spec allows any App that can read the branch. Agents hold no legion-envoy key, so the live run uses the implement App (implementer) and the review App (tester). legion-envoy's token reaches the same Ref in production through root A2's imports after the root applies Design step 3. Whether that satisfies root A3 is the architect's call.

The production check can confirm the running build carries the merge, but the changed paths run in production only after the root's Design step 3 (Secret Sync plus the four App inputs), and nothing applies the image mover's pin until dispatch://INFRA-154 lands.

findings.finding: Root A3 names legion-envoy's token; the child allows any App that can read the branch, and the role-App run may not satisfy root A3.
findings.answer: Plan D7: the run uses the pane's role App as the child spec allows and records which App ran it (JJ_USER); whether that satisfies root A3 is sent to the architect in the completion message (decisionsForArchitect).

findings.finding: 320 files does not establish a qualifying fixture: acceptance is the bytes of one unpaginated JSON answer; 'no existing main commit exceeds 1 MiB' was not proven by the two measurements.
findings.answer: P2 sizes content by patch bytes (~7 KB per file, 300 listed), step 4 measures one gh api answer > 1048576 and rebuilds otherwise; T5's precondition measures one uncapped JSON answer and fails naming the size when it is too small. The plan states only the commits measured (four largest by file count), not an exhaustive search.

findings.finding: A loader unit test is not a real boot; the key change needs a production-like boot proof.
findings.answer: A-key proof boots the real envoy-dispatch binary over the in-pod Postgres with the plain and the base64 form (loaded github app log, /healthz 200), the malformed forms exit 1, and the browser suite boots it from a plain PEM through run-server.sh (T7) and drives an App-signed source save and import.

findings.finding: Parsing at load must not reject an absent key (client-ID-only App), and must keep env-over-app.json precedence and PKCS1/PKCS8.
findings.answer: D1/D2 parse only a non-empty value; app.json unchanged; T2 cases (d) PKCS#8 and (i) client ID with no key.

findings.finding: The negative control's restore boundary is ambiguous; it must run the identical live test against the old implementation.
findings.answer: P3 restores every non-test .go file the change modified in the package under test (client.go and deliveries.go for githubapp, app.go for auth), keeps all _test.go files, and requires output showing the test ran and failed with the limit error, not SKIP or a build error; T4/T5 use only base symbols.

findings.finding: The image mover's behaviour was asserted, not read; merge, image, pin and running build are distinct observations.
